name: Pauli's egg dream — spontaneous division, conscious participation and the circle
description: The seven pictures in sequence: the egg laid and self-divided, the egg found in the dreamer's hand, the division that keeps wholeness, four eggs become expressions, the conjugate quotient, and the spoken circle.

scenes.name: A physicist meets his concepts in a dream
scenes.character: Background physics: physical concepts appearing spontaneously in dreams, in a qualitative symbolic sense — received before it is chosen.

entities.name: the dreamer — Pauli, after the Kepler work, mid-March
ψ
the companion dream — brass tones engraved on a plate, the ground state changed
Fierz's note — an undated typescript, an outline not a finished publication

text.title: Background physics
text.italic: Concepts arrive in dreams, unbidden and qualitative.

scenes.name: Pictures 1–2: the egg laid; the egg divides itself
scenes.character: The first division happens before the dreamer intervenes; one has become two while each remains presented as an egg.

entities.name: the woman with the bird — unnamed; their action brings the egg
picture 1 — the single egg, awaiting what will happen
picture 2 — the egg divides itself, without the dreamer's intervention

text.title: The egg divides itself
text.italic: One has become two; each remains an egg.

scenes.name: Pictures 3–4: the egg in his own hand; division that keeps wholeness
scenes.character: The dreamer goes closer, finds a blue-shelled egg already held, divides it — and the two miraculously remain whole.

entities.name: pictures 1–2 — the spontaneous pair above
picture 3 — the blue-shelled egg already in his hand
picture 4 — divided by him, both remain whole
the dreamer — approaches, notices, participates

scenes.name: Pictures 5–6: four eggs become expressions; the conjugate quotient
scenes.character: The duplicated cos/sin rows form a relation of conjugate expressions — the cosine the same, the imaginary sine term changing sign.

entities.name: picture 5 — four expressions in two rows
picture 6 — the conjugate quotient, modulus one
no shell-to-function assignment added — eggs and expressions, unjoined

text.title: Eggs become expressions
text.italic: The cosine holds; the imaginary term changes sign.

scenes.name: Picture 7: he speaks, and the circle appears
scenes.character: Pauli speaks for the first time: the expression is e^{iδ}; the formula vanishes and a circle appears. Speech enters at the end.

entities.name: formula → circle — the dream's own replacement
a point for fixed angle, the circle as the angle varies
seven pictures, complete — no eighth scene, no return of the woman and bird

text.title: He speaks
text.italic: The formula vanishes; a circle appears.

scenes.name: Pauli reads the part played by consciousness
scenes.character: The spontaneous pair read as a ground state; his participation produces the quaternity through a reflection of duality; the Maria Prophetissa comparison is his; he refuses a finished interpretation.

entities.name: the ground state — the spontaneous pair read as one
the noticing eye — attention as the first act
i
the refusal — further progress in the sciences would be required
Neumann's round compared — no egg-to-stage assignment

text.title: The conscious part
text.italic: Noticing and dividing what he already holds.

scenes.name: Return: the recovered telling and its authorial office
scenes.character: He has received, approached, noticed, divided and finally spoken. What arrives without choice becomes an operation in which he participates.

entities.name: the circle — the dream's end, exact in its own scope
the four eggs with two different origins — retained
X/x
the observer inside the operation — A19's comparison drawn

text.title: Received, then participated
text.italic: Seven pictures; four eggs of two origins.
